# Dependencies for the deployed orchestrator.
#
# ADK generates a minimal file when this is absent, and that generated file
# does not include the Firestore client — so the agent deploys cleanly, calls
# its own tool, and fails with an ImportError only when a person finally asks
# it a question. Naming the dependencies here is what makes the deployed image
# match what the tool actually imports.
#
# Deliberately short. Nothing on this path reasons about a model other than
# through ADK, and nothing writes, so there is no reason to ship more.
#
# Versions match constraints-3.12.txt. The deployed agent is the agent that was
# tested, or it is a different agent.
google-cloud-aiplatform[adk,agent_engines]
google-adk==2.8.0
google-cloud-firestore==2.29.0
python-dotenv==1.2.3
